                        subs.claims
                    from
                        unnest(subscriptions) subs
                    where
                        subs.entity = entity_
                        and subs.claims_role = working_role
                        and (
                            realtime.is_visible_through_filters(columns, subs.filters)
                            or (
                              action = 'DELETE'
                              and realtime.is_visible_through_filters(old_columns, subs.filters)
                            )
                        )
            ) loop

                if not is_rls_enabled or action = 'DELETE' then
                    visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id;
                else
                    -- Check if RLS allows the role to see the record
                    perform
                        -- Trim leading and trailing quotes from working_role because set_config
                        -- doesn't recognize the role as valid if they are included
                        set_config('role', trim(both '"' from working_role::text), true),
                        set_config('request.jwt.claims', claims::text, true);

                    execute 'execute walrus_rls_stmt' into subscription_has_access;

                    -- Reset the role on every FOR..LOOP batch execution.
                    -- The first batch of 10 rows is pre-fetched using the current connection role (PG internal behaviour)
                    -- then we have to reset it again otherwise it would use the role defined in the `set_config` above
                    -- to fetch the remaining rows when rows>10, which could be a user-defined role that lacks execution grants.
                    -- The flow is:
                    --   1. run batch with conn role
                    --   2. set_config working_role
                    --   3. execute walrus
                    --   4. reset role (revert)
                    --   5. repeat
                    perform set_config('role', null, true);

                    if subscription_has_access then
                        visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id;
                    end if;
                end if;
            end loop;

            perform set_config('role', null, true);

            -- Inner loop: per distinct selected_columns for this role
            for cols_record in
                select selected_columns
                from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t
                order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '')
            loop
                working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns;

                output = jsonb_build_object(
                    'schema', wal ->> 'schema',
                    'table', wal ->> 'table',
                    'type', action,
                    'commit_timestamp', to_char(
                        ((wal ->> 'timestamp')::timestamptz at time zone 'utc'),
                        'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'
                    ),
                    'columns', (
                        select
                            jsonb_agg(
                                jsonb_build_object(
                                    'name', pa.attname,
                                    'type', pt.typname
                                )
                                order by pa.attnum asc
                            )
                        from
                            pg_attribute pa
                            join pg_type pt
                                on pa.atttypid = pt.oid
                            left join (
                                select unnest(conkey) as pkey_attnum
                                from pg_constraint
                                where conrelid = entity_ and contype = 'p'
                            ) pk on pk.pkey_attnum = pa.attnum
                        where
                            attrelid = entity_
                            and attnum > 0
                            and pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, pa.attname, 'SELECT')
                            and (working_selected_columns is null or pa.attname = any(working_selected_columns) or pk.pkey_attnum is not null)
                    )
                )
                -- Add "record" key for insert and update
                || case
                    when action in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') then
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'record',
                            (
                                select
                                    jsonb_object_agg(
                                        -- if unchanged toast, get column name and value from old record
                                        coalesce((c).name, (oc).name),
                                        case
                                            when (c).name is null then (oc).value
                                            else (c).value
                                        end
                                    )
                                from
                                    unnest(columns) c
                                    full outer join unnest(old_columns) oc
                                        on (c).name = (oc).name
                                where
                                    coalesce((c).is_selectable, (oc).is_selectable)
                                    and (working_selected_columns is null or coalesce((c).name, (oc).name) = any(working_selected_columns) or coalesce((c).is_pkey, (oc).is_pkey))
                                    and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64))
                            )
                        )
                    else '{}'::jsonb
                end
                -- Add "old_record" key for update and delete
                || case
                    when action = 'UPDATE' then
                        jsonb_build_object(
                                'old_record',
                                (
                                    select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value)
                                    from unnest(old_columns) c
                                    where
                                        (c).is_selectable
                                        and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey)
                                        and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64))
                                )
                            )
                    when action = 'DELETE' then
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'old_record',
                            (
                                select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value)
                                from unnest(old_columns) c
                                where
                                    (c).is_selectable
                                    and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey)
                                    and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64))
                                    and ( not is_rls_enabled or (c).is_pkey ) -- if RLS enabled, we can't secure deletes so filter to pkey
                            )
                        )
                    else '{}'::jsonb
                end;

                -- Filter visible_role_sub_ids to those matching the current selected_columns group
                visible_to_subscription_ids = coalesce(
                    (
                        select array_agg(s.subscription_id)
                        from unnest(subscriptions) s
                        where s.claims_role = working_role
                          and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)
                          and s.subscription_id = any(visible_role_sub_ids)
                    ),
                    '{}'::uuid[]
                );

                return next (
                    output,
                    is_rls_enabled,
                    visible_to_subscription_ids,
                    case
                        when error_record_exceeds_max_size then array['Error 413: Payload Too Large']
                        else '{}'
                    end
                )::realtime.wal_rls;
            end loop;

        end if;
    end loop;

    perform set_config('role', null, true);
end;
$function$

procedure:realtime.build_prepared_statem.source_code:
/*
      Builds a sql string that, if executed, creates a prepared statement to
      tests retrive a row from *entity* by its primary key columns.
      Example
          select realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql('public.notes', '{"id"}'::text[], '{"bigint"}'::text[])
      */
          select
      'prepare ' || prepared_statement_name || ' as
          select
              exists(
                  select
                      1
                  from
                      ' || entity || '
                  where
                      ' || string_agg(quote_ident(pkc.name) || '=' || quote_nullable(pkc.value #>> '{}') , ' and ') || '
              )'
          from
              unnest(columns) pkc
          where
              pkc.is_pkey
          group by
              entity

procedure:realtime.check_equality_op(rea.source_code:
/*
Casts *val_1* and *val_2* as type *type_* and check the *op* condition for truthiness
*/
declare
    op_symbol text = (
        case
            when op = 'eq' then '='
            when op = 'neq' then '!='
            when op = 'lt' then '<'
            when op = 'lte' then '<='
            when op = 'gt' then '>'
            when op = 'gte' then '>='
            when op = 'in' then '= any'
            else 'UNKNOWN OP'
        end
    );
    res boolean;
begin
    execute format(
        'select %L::'|| type_::text || ' ' || op_symbol
        || ' ( %L::'
        || (
            case
                when op = 'in' then type_::text || '[]'
                else type_::text end
        )
        || ')', val_1, val_2) into res;
    return res;
end;

procedure:realtime.is_visible_through_fi.name: is_visible_through_filters
procedure:realtime.is_visible_through_fi.source_code:
select
        filters is null
        or array_length(filters, 1) is null
        or coalesce(
            count(col.name) = count(1)
            and sum(
                realtime.check_equality_op(
                    op:=f.op,
                    type_:=coalesce(col.type_oid::regtype, col.type_name::regtype),
                    val_1:=col.value #>> '{}',
                    val_2:=f.value,
                    negate:=coalesce(f.negate, false)
                )::int
            ) filter (where col.name is not null) = count(col.name),
            false
        )
    from
        unnest(filters) f
        left join unnest(columns) col
            on f.column_name = col.name;
procedure:realtime.is_visible_through_fi.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.is_visible_through_filters(columns realtime.wal_column[], filters realtime.user_defined_filter[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
    select
        filters is null
        or array_length(filters, 1) is null
        or coalesce(
            count(col.name) = count(1)
            and sum(
                realtime.check_equality_op(
                    op:=f.op,
                    type_:=coalesce(col.type_oid::regtype, col.type_name::regtype),
                    val_1:=col.value #>> '{}',
                    val_2:=f.value,
                    negate:=coalesce(f.negate, false)
                )::int
            ) filter (where col.name is not null) = count(col.name),
            false
        )
    from
        unnest(filters) f
        left join unnest(columns) col
            on f.column_name = col.name;
$function$

procedure:realtime.list_changes(name,nam.name: list_changes
procedure:realtime.list_changes(name,nam.source_code:
WITH pub AS (
    SELECT
      concat_ws(
        ',',
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubinsert) THEN 'insert' ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubupdate) THEN 'update' ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubdelete) THEN 'delete' ELSE NULL END
      ) AS w2j_actions,
      coalesce(
        string_agg(
          realtime.quote_wal2json(format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename)::regclass),
          ','
        ) filter (WHERE ppt.tablename IS NOT NULL),
        ''
      ) AS w2j_add_tables
    FROM pg_publication pp
    LEFT JOIN pg_publication_tables ppt ON pp.pubname = ppt.pubname
    WHERE pp.pubname = publication
    GROUP BY pp.pubname
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  -- MATERIALIZED ensures pg_logical_slot_get_changes is called exactly once
  w2j AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT x.*, pub.w2j_add_tables
    FROM pub,
         pg_logical_slot_get_changes(
           slot_name, null, max_changes,
           'include-pk', 'true',
           'include-transaction', 'false',
           'include-timestamp', 'true',
           'include-type-oids', 'true',
           'format-version', '2',
           'actions', pub.w2j_actions,
           'add-tables', pub.w2j_add_tables
         ) x
  ),
  slot_count AS (
    SELECT count(*)::bigint AS cnt
    FROM w2j
    WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> ''
  ),
  rls_filtered AS (
    SELECT xyz.wal, xyz.is_rls_enabled, xyz.subscription_ids, xyz.errors
    FROM w2j,
         realtime.apply_rls(
           wal := w2j.data::jsonb,
           max_record_bytes := max_record_bytes
         ) xyz(wal, is_rls_enabled, subscription_ids, errors)
    WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> ''
      AND xyz.subscription_ids[1] IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT rf.wal, rf.is_rls_enabled, rf.subscription_ids, rf.errors, sc.cnt
  FROM rls_filtered rf, slot_count sc

  UNION ALL

  SELECT null, null, null, null, sc.cnt
  FROM slot_count sc
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rls_filtered)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.list_changes(publication name, slot_name name, max_changes integer, max_record_bytes integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(wal jsonb, is_rls_enabled boolean, subscription_ids uuid[], errors text[], slot_changes_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET log_min_messages TO 'fatal'
AS $function$
  WITH pub AS (
    SELECT
      concat_ws(
        ',',
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubinsert) THEN 'insert' ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubupdate) THEN 'update' ELSE NULL END,
        CASE WHEN bool_or(pubdelete) THEN 'delete' ELSE NULL END
      ) AS w2j_actions,
      coalesce(
        string_agg(
          realtime.quote_wal2json(format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename)::regclass),
          ','
        ) filter (WHERE ppt.tablename IS NOT NULL),
        ''
      ) AS w2j_add_tables
    FROM pg_publication pp
    LEFT JOIN pg_publication_tables ppt ON pp.pubname = ppt.pubname
    WHERE pp.pubname = publication
    GROUP BY pp.pubname
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  -- MATERIALIZED ensures pg_logical_slot_get_changes is called exactly once
  w2j AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT x.*, pub.w2j_add_tables
    FROM pub,
         pg_logical_slot_get_changes(
           slot_name, null, max_changes,
           'include-pk', 'true',
           'include-transaction', 'false',
           'include-timestamp', 'true',
           'include-type-oids', 'true',
           'format-version', '2',
           'actions', pub.w2j_actions,
           'add-tables', pub.w2j_add_tables
         ) x
  ),
  slot_count AS (
    SELECT count(*)::bigint AS cnt
    FROM w2j
    WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> ''
  ),
  rls_filtered AS (
    SELECT xyz.wal, xyz.is_rls_enabled, xyz.subscription_ids, xyz.errors
    FROM w2j,
         realtime.apply_rls(
           wal := w2j.data::jsonb,
           max_record_bytes := max_record_bytes
         ) xyz(wal, is_rls_enabled, subscription_ids, errors)
    WHERE w2j.w2j_add_tables <> ''
      AND xyz.subscription_ids[1] IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT rf.wal, rf.is_rls_enabled, rf.subscription_ids, rf.errors, sc.cnt
  FROM rls_filtered rf, slot_count sc

  UNION ALL

  SELECT null, null, null, null, sc.cnt
  FROM slot_count sc
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rls_filtered)
$function$

procedure:storage.allow_any_operation(te.source_code:
WITH current_operation AS (
    SELECT storage.operation() AS raw_operation
  ),
  normalized AS (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN raw_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(raw_operation, 9)
      ELSE raw_operation
    END AS current_operation
    FROM current_operation
  )
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM normalized n
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(expected_operations) AS expected_operation
    WHERE expected_operation IS NOT NULL
      AND expected_operation <> ''
      AND n.current_operation = CASE
        WHEN expected_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(expected_operation, 9)
        ELSE expected_operation
      END
  );

procedure:storage.allow_only_operation(t.source_code:
WITH current_operation AS (
    SELECT storage.operation() AS raw_operation
  ),
  normalized AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN raw_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(raw_operation, 9)
        ELSE raw_operation
      END AS current_operation,
      CASE
        WHEN expected_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(expected_operation, 9)
        ELSE expected_operation
      END AS requested_operation
    FROM current_operation
  )
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN requested_operation IS NULL OR requested_operation = '' THEN FALSE
    ELSE COALESCE(current_operation = requested_operation, FALSE)
  END
  FROM normalized;

procedure:storage.extension(text).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.extension(name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
    _parts text[];
    _filename text;
BEGIN
    -- Split on "/" to get path segments
    SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
    -- Get the last path segment (the actual filename)
    SELECT _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)] INTO _filename;
    -- Extract extension: reverse, split on '.', then reverse again
    RETURN reverse(split_part(reverse(_filename), '.', 1));
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.get_common_prefix(p_key text, p_prefix text, p_delimiter text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
SELECT CASE
    WHEN position(p_delimiter IN substring(p_key FROM length(p_prefix) + 1)) > 0
    THEN left(p_key, length(p_prefix) + position(p_delimiter IN substring(p_key FROM length(p_prefix) + 1)))

END;

procedure:storage.list_multipart_uploads.source_code:
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE
        'SELECT DISTINCT ON(key COLLATE "C") * from (
            SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN position($2 IN substring(key from length($1) + 1)) > 0 THEN
                        substring(key from 1 for length($1) + position($2 IN substring(key from length($1) + 1)))
                    ELSE
                        key
                END AS key, id, created_at
            FROM
                storage.s3_multipart_uploads
            WHERE
                bucket_id = $5 AND
                key ILIKE $1 || ''%'' AND
                CASE
                    WHEN $4 != '''' AND $6 = '''' THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN position($2 IN substring(key from length($1) + 1)) > 0 THEN
                                substring(key from 1 for length($1) + position($2 IN substring(key from length($1) + 1))) COLLATE "C" > $4
                            ELSE
                                key COLLATE "C" > $4
                            END
                    ELSE
                        true
                END AND
                CASE
                    WHEN $6 != '''' THEN
                        id COLLATE "C" > $6
                    ELSE
                        true
                    END
            ORDER BY
                key COLLATE "C" ASC, created_at ASC) as e order by key COLLATE "C" LIMIT $3'
        USING prefix_param, delimiter_param, max_keys, next_key_token, bucket_id, next_upload_token;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.protect_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Check if storage.allow_delete_query is set to 'true'
    IF COALESCE(current_setting('storage.allow_delete_query', true), 'false') != 'true' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Direct deletion from storage tables is not allowed. Use the Storage API instead.'
            USING HINT = 'This prevents accidental data loss from orphaned objects.',
                  ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

procedure:storage.search_by_timestamp(te.name: search_by_timestamp
procedure:storage.search_by_timestamp(te.source_code:
DECLARE
    v_cursor_op text;
    v_query text;
    v_prefix text;
BEGIN
    v_prefix := coalesce(p_prefix, '');

    IF p_sort_order = 'asc' THEN
        v_cursor_op := '>';
    ELSE
        v_cursor_op := '<';
    END IF;

    v_query := format($sql$
        WITH raw_objects AS (
            SELECT
                o.name AS obj_name,
                o.id AS obj_id,
                o.updated_at AS obj_updated_at,
                o.created_at AS obj_created_at,
                o.last_accessed_at AS obj_last_accessed_at,
                o.metadata AS obj_metadata,
                storage.get_common_prefix(o.name, $1, '/') AS common_prefix
            FROM storage.objects o
            WHERE o.bucket_id = $2
              AND o.name COLLATE "C" LIKE $1 || '%%'
        ),
        -- Aggregate common prefixes (folders)
        -- Both created_at and updated_at use MIN(obj_created_at) to match the old prefixes table behavior
        aggregated_prefixes AS (
            SELECT
                rtrim(common_prefix, '/') AS name,
                NULL::uuid AS id,
                MIN(obj_created_at) AS updated_at,
                MIN(obj_created_at) AS created_at,
                NULL::timestamptz AS last_accessed_at,
                NULL::jsonb AS metadata,
                TRUE AS is_prefix
            FROM raw_objects
            WHERE common_prefix IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY common_prefix
        ),
        leaf_objects AS (
            SELECT
                obj_name AS name,
                obj_id AS id,
                obj_updated_at AS updated_at,
                obj_created_at AS created_at,
                obj_last_accessed_at AS last_accessed_at,
                obj_metadata AS metadata,
                FALSE AS is_prefix
            FROM raw_objects
            WHERE common_prefix IS NULL
        ),
        combined AS (
            SELECT * FROM aggregated_prefixes
            UNION ALL
            SELECT * FROM leaf_objects
        ),
        filtered AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM combined
            WHERE (
                $5 = ''
                OR ROW(
                    date_trunc('milliseconds', %I),
                    name COLLATE "C"
                ) %s ROW(
                    COALESCE(NULLIF($6, '')::timestamptz, 'epoch'::timestamptz),
                    $5
                )
            )
        )
        SELECT
            split_part(name, '/', $3) AS key,
            name,
            id,
            updated_at,
            created_at,
            last_accessed_at,
            metadata
        FROM filtered
        ORDER BY
            COALESCE(date_trunc('milliseconds', %I), 'epoch'::timestamptz) %s,
            name COLLATE "C" %s
        LIMIT $4
    $sql$,
        p_sort_column,
        v_cursor_op,
        p_sort_column,
        p_sort_order,
        p_sort_order
    );

    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE v_query
    USING v_prefix, p_bucket_id, p_level, p_limit, p_start_after, p_sort_column_after;
END;

rlsPolicy:public.job_match_events.job_ma.name: job_match_events_visible
rlsPolicy:public.job_match_events.job_ma.using_expression:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.job_matches m
  WHERE ((m.id = job_match_events.match_id) AND ((m.pro_id = auth.uid()) OR public.owns_job(m.job_id))))) OR public.is_admin())

rlsPolicy:public.material_line_items.mat.name: material_line_items_party
rlsPolicy:public.material_line_items.mat.using_expression:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.material_requests r
  WHERE ((r.id = material_line_items.request_id) AND ((r.pro_id = auth.uid()) OR (r.customer_id = auth.uid()))))) OR public.is_admin())

rlsPolicy:public.material_line_items.mat.name: material_line_items_pro_write
rlsPolicy:public.material_line_items.mat.using_expression:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.material_requests r
  WHERE ((r.id = material_line_items.request_id) AND (r.pro_id = auth.uid()))))
rlsPolicy:public.material_line_items.mat.with_check_expression:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.material_requests r
  WHERE ((r.id = material_line_items.request_id) AND (r.pro_id = auth.uid()))))

rlsPolicy:public.price_quotes.price_quot.name: price_quotes_visible
rlsPolicy:public.price_quotes.price_quot.using_expression:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.jobs j
  WHERE ((j.price_quote_id = price_quotes.id) AND (j.customer_id = auth.uid())))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.bookings b
  WHERE ((b.price_quote_id = price_quotes.id) AND ((b.customer_id = auth.uid()) OR (b.pro_id = auth.uid()))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (public.job_matches m
     JOIN public.jobs j2 ON ((j2.id = m.job_id)))
  WHERE ((j2.price_quote_id = price_quotes.id) AND (m.pro_id = auth.uid())))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.scope_changes s
  WHERE ((s.price_quote_id = price_quotes.id) AND ((s.pro_id = auth.uid()) OR (s.customer_id = auth.uid()))))) OR public.is_admin())
rlsPolicy:public.price_quotes.price_quot.comment: A quote is readable by the parties to whatever it prices — a job, a booking, a match, or a scope change. Never writable by any client role.

rlsPolicy:public.pro_favourites.pro_favo.name: pro_favourites_insert_own
rlsPolicy:public.pro_favourites.pro_favo.with_check_expression:
((customer_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.pro_public_profiles v
  WHERE (v.pro_id = pro_favourites.pro_id))))

view:public.job_pro_results.name: job_pro_results
view:public.job_pro_results.definition:
SELECT m.job_id,
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.status AS match_status,
    m.available_start_at,
    m.available_end_at,
    m.interest_note,
    m.distance_meters,
    m.interested_at,
    p.profile_id AS pro_id,
    pr.full_name,
    pr.avatar_path,
    p.business_name,
    p.account_type,
    p.bio,
    p.years_experience,
    p.rating_average,
    p.rating_count,
    p.completed_jobs_count,
    p.is_new_pro,
    (p.approval_state = 'approved'::public.verification_state) AS is_verified,
    public.pro_is_licensed_and_insured(p.profile_id) AS is_licensed_and_insured,
    (m.status = 'interested'::public.match_status) AS is_available_for_this_job,
    public.effective_rating(p.rating_average, p.rating_count) AS effective_rating,
    public.pro_fit_score(p.rating_average, p.rating_count, p.completed_jobs_count, p.years_experience, m.distance_meters, (m.status = 'interested'::public.match_status), public.pro_is_licensed_and_insured(p.profile_id)) AS fit_score,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.status = 'interested'::public.match_status) THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END AS result_group,
    psc.additional_time_rate_cents,
    public.estimated_additional_hourly_cents(psc.additional_time_rate_cents, j.category_id, j.final_priority) AS estimated_additional_hourly_cents,
    COALESCE(psc.rate_currency, 'USD'::text) AS rate_currency
   FROM ((((public.job_matches m
     JOIN public.pro_profiles p ON ((p.profile_id = m.pro_id)))
     JOIN public.profiles pr ON ((pr.id = p.profile_id)))
     JOIN public.jobs j ON ((j.id = m.job_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.pro_service_categories psc ON (((psc.pro_id = m.pro_id) AND (psc.category_id = j.category_id))))
  WHERE (public.owns_job(m.job_id) AND (m.status <> ALL (ARRAY['withdrawn'::public.match_status, 'expired'::public.match_status, 'not_selected'::public.match_status])))

view:public.my_bookings.name: my_bookings
view:public.my_bookings.definition:
SELECT b.id AS booking_id,
    b.job_id,
    b.status,
    public.booking_is_terminal(b.status) AS is_closed,
    (b.customer_id = auth.uid()) AS i_am_customer,
    b.scheduled_start,
    b.scheduled_end,
    b.created_at,
    b.completed_at,
    b.cancelled_at,
    j.title AS job_title,
    sc.name AS category_name,
    cp.counterpart_id,
    cp.display_name AS counterpart_display_name,
    cp.avatar_path AS counterpart_avatar_path
   FROM (((public.bookings b
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.booking_counterpart(b.id) cp(counterpart_id, display_name, avatar_path) ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN public.jobs j ON ((j.id = b.job_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.service_categories sc ON ((sc.id = b.category_id)))
  WHERE ((b.customer_id = auth.uid()) OR (b.pro_id = auth.uid()))
view:public.my_bookings.comment: The caller's bookings, either side. No amounts and no address — the list says which job and when; the detail screen is where either matters.

view:public.my_conversations.name: my_conversations
view:public.my_conversations.definition:
SELECT c.id AS conversation_id,
    c.booking_id,
    b.status AS booking_status,
    public.booking_is_terminal(b.status) AS is_booking_closed,
    (NOT public.chat_sending_open(c.booking_id)) AS is_read_only,
    public.chat_sending_closes_at(c.booking_id) AS sending_closes_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (b.customer_id = auth.uid()) THEN b.pro_id
            ELSE b.customer_id
        END AS counterpart_id,
    cp.display_name AS counterpart_display_name,
    cp.avatar_path AS counterpart_avatar_path,
    j.title AS job_title,
    sc.name AS category_name,
    c.last_message_at,
    ( SELECT m.body
           FROM public.chat_messages m
          WHERE (m.conversation_id = c.id)
          ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_message_preview,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.chat_messages m
          WHERE ((m.conversation_id = c.id) AND (m.sender_id <> auth.uid()) AND (m.created_at > COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.customer_id = auth.uid()) THEN c.customer_last_read_at
                    ELSE c.pro_last_read_at
                END, '-infinity'::timestamp with time zone)))) AS unread_count
   FROM ((((public.conversations c
     JOIN public.bookings b ON ((b.id = c.booking_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.chat_counterpart(c.id) cp(counterpart_id, display_name, avatar_path) ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN public.jobs j ON ((j.id = b.job_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.service_categories sc ON ((sc.id = b.category_id)))
  WHERE ((b.customer_id = auth.uid()) OR (b.pro_id = auth.uid()))
view:public.my_conversations.comment: Chat list. Booking id, status and a permitted display name only — no address, contact detail, price, evidence path or signed URL.

view:public.my_payment_methods.name: my_payment_methods
view:public.my_payment_methods.definition:
SELECT id,
    brand,
    last4,
    exp_month,
    exp_year,
    funding,
    is_default,
    (((make_date(COALESCE(exp_year, 2100), COALESCE(exp_month, 12), 1) + '1 mon'::interval) - '1 day'::interval) < CURRENT_DATE) AS is_expired,
    created_at
   FROM public.payment_methods pm
  WHERE ((profile_id = auth.uid()) AND (detached_at IS NULL))
  ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at DESC
view:public.my_payment_methods.comment: The caller's usable cards. No Stripe id: that is the handle to the instrument and a client has no use for it.

view:public.my_profile.name: my_profile
view:public.my_profile.definition:
SELECT p.id,
    p.role,
    p.full_name,
    p.display_name,
    p.avatar_path,
    p.phone_e164,
    (p.phone_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS phone_verified,
    p.locale,
    p.timezone,
    p.is_active,
    p.is_anonymous,
    (p.verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_verified,
    p.created_at,
    pp.business_name,
    pp.bio,
    pp.years_experience,
    pp.approval_state,
    (pp.approved_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_approved,
    pp.is_accepting_work,
    pp.payouts_enabled,
    pp.rating_average,
    pp.rating_count,
    pp.completed_jobs_count
   FROM (public.profiles p
     LEFT JOIN public.pro_profiles pp ON ((pp.profile_id = p.id)))
  WHERE (p.id = auth.uid())
view:public.my_profile.comment: The signed-in user's own profile. Excludes legacy_user_id and ein_last4; exposes verification and phone verification as booleans rather than the timestamps, which are the platform's record rather than the user's.

view:public.my_saved_pros.name: my_saved_pros
view:public.my_saved_pros.definition:
SELECT f.pro_id,
    f.created_at AS saved_at,
    pub.display_name,
    pub.avatar_path,
    pub.bio,
    pub.years_experience,
    pub.is_verified,
    pub.is_licensed_and_insured,
    pub.rating_average,
    pub.rating_count,
    pub.completed_jobs_count,
    pub.is_new_pro,
    pub.is_accepting_work
   FROM (public.pro_favourites f
     JOIN public.pro_public_profiles pub ON ((pub.pro_id = f.pro_id)))
  WHERE (f.customer_id = auth.uid())
view:public.my_saved_pros.comment: Saved pros through pro_public_profiles, so a saved pro reveals exactly what a browsed pro does.

view:public.my_verifications.name: my_verifications
view:public.my_verifications.definition:
SELECT id,
    kind,
    state,
    (storage_path IS NOT NULL) AS has_document,
    issued_at,
    expires_at,
    rejection_reason,
    reviewed_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM public.pro_verifications v
  WHERE (pro_id = auth.uid())
view:public.my_verifications.comment: The pro's own verification standing. Names no reviewer and exposes no storage path — the document is fetched by a signed URL, not by guessing.

view:public.pro_job_opportunities.name: pro_job_opportunities
view:public.pro_job_opportunities.definition:
SELECT m.id AS match_id,
    m.status AS match_status,
    m.available_start_at,
    m.available_end_at,
    m.interest_note,
    m.distance_meters,
    m.created_at AS matched_at,
    j.id AS job_id,
    j.title,
    j.description,
    j.category_id,
    j.final_priority,
    j.estimated_duration_minutes,
    j.requested_service_start,
    j.requested_service_end,
    j.is_flexible,
    j.status AS job_status,
    j.published_at,
    j.matching_expires_at,
    j.requires_license_insurance,
    j.approx_location,
    q.labor_amount_cents,
    q.expected_payout_cents,
    q.currency
   FROM ((public.job_matches m
     JOIN public.jobs j ON ((j.id = m.job_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.price_quotes q ON ((q.id = j.price_quote_id)))
  WHERE (m.pro_id = auth.uid())
view:public.pro_job_opportunities.comment: The only route by which a pro reads job data. Exact address, customer identity and contact details are not projected.

view:public.pro_public_categories.name: pro_public_categories
view:public.pro_public_categories.definition:
SELECT psc.pro_id,
    psc.category_id,
    sc.slug,
    sc.name
   FROM ((public.pro_service_categories psc
     JOIN public.service_categories sc ON ((sc.id = psc.category_id)))
     JOIN public.pro_profiles p ON ((p.profile_id = psc.pro_id)))
  WHERE ((psc.approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (p.approval_state = 'approved'::public.verification_state) AND (p.suspended_at IS NULL))

view:public.pro_public_profiles.name: pro_public_profiles
view:public.pro_public_profiles.definition:
SELECT p.profile_id AS pro_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p.business_name), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(pr.display_name), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(pr.full_name), ''::text), 'Tarea Pro'::text) AS display_name,
    pr.avatar_path,
    p.business_logo_path,
    p.bio,
    p.years_experience,
    true AS is_verified,
    public.pro_is_licensed_and_insured(p.profile_id) AS is_licensed_and_insured,
    p.rating_average,
    p.rating_count,
    p.completed_jobs_count,
    p.is_new_pro,
    p.is_accepting_work,
    public.effective_rating(p.rating_average, p.rating_count) AS effective_rating
   FROM (public.pro_profiles p
     JOIN public.profiles pr ON ((pr.id = p.profile_id)))
  WHERE ((p.approval_state = 'approved'::public.verification_state) AND (p.suspended_at IS NULL) AND pr.is_active)
view:public.pro_public_profiles.comment: The ONLY pro data a browsing customer may read. Excludes payment infrastructure, administrative notes, tax identifiers, private contact details, account internals and all service-area geometry. A column added to pro_profiles is private until it is named here.

view:public.pro_public_skills.name: pro_public_skills
view:public.pro_public_skills.definition:
SELECT ps.pro_id,
    ps.skill_id,
    s.slug,
    s.name
   FROM ((public.pro_skills ps
     JOIN public.skills s ON ((s.id = ps.skill_id)))
     JOIN public.pro_profiles p ON ((p.profile_id = ps.pro_id)))
  WHERE ((p.approval_state = 'approved'::public.verification_state) AND (p.suspended_at IS NULL))

view:public.pro_reviews.name: pro_reviews
view:public.pro_reviews.definition:
SELECT r.id AS review_id,
    r.reviewee_id AS pro_id,
    r.rating,
    r.comment,
    r.reply,
    r.replied_at,
    r.created_at,
    a.reviewer_name,
    a.avatar_path AS reviewer_avatar_path,
    sc.name AS category_name
   FROM (((public.reviews r
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL public.review_author(r.id) a(reviewer_name, avatar_path) ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN public.bookings b ON ((b.id = r.booking_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.service_categories sc ON ((sc.id = b.category_id)))
view:public.pro_reviews.comment: Public reputation. Names the reviewer as they choose to be named; carries no contact detail, address or amount.
